name: agent-obsidian-mcp-monorepo
description: Local MCP servers for the Agent-Obsidian workflow (vault-workspace-mcp, paper-fetch-mcp). Single repo · single version tag · single GitHub Release.

scripts.pack:all: mkdir -p dist && npm pack --workspace packages/vault-workspace-mcp --pack-destination dist && npm pack --workspace packages/paper-fetch-mcp --pack-destination dist
